== Summary ==
Star Trek CCG finalist Mike Harrington of Minnesota has lost his voice, but not his game. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
